### [AOD-9604 — Technical Specification](https://docs.peptidesourcehub.net/specs/aod-9604)

**URL:** https://docs.peptidesourcehub.net/specs/aod-9604

**Summary:** Factory-direct AOD-9604 wholesale. CAS 221231-10-3, ~1,815.1 Da. ≥99% HPLC. hGH fragment 177-191 — selective adipose lipolysis. COA included.

**Key Entities:**
- CAS 221231-10-3
- Sequence: H-YLRIVQCRSVEGSCGF-OH (cyclic, Cys⁷–Cys¹⁴ disulfide)
- Molecular Formula: C₇₈H₁₂₃N₂₃O₂₃S₂
- Molecular Weight: ~1,815.1 Da
- Amino Acid Count: 16 (cyclic via disulfide bond)
